name: Locke Silverfang
source:
"An enigma, even to their teachers.
A still pond under which lurks untold monsters.

Passive and observant, Locke may be one of the few who truly understands the unfolding situation in the Academy."
- Itch.io marketing, 'Information Module - Locke'
